title: Strict gates have fan-in at most two
statement: Let $g$ be a Boolean gate whose argument indices are pairwise distinct and whose argument list has length one if $g$ is a NOT gate and length two otherwise. Then its argument indices are pairwise distinct, a NOT gate has exactly one argument, and $g$ has at most two arguments.
hypotheses_covered: The gate's argument indices are pairwise distinct.
The gate has one argument if it is a NOT gate and two arguments otherwise.
